# app_projects

Use Python 3.12. Run uv sync.
Set DATABASE_URL to a PostgreSQL URL. Run uv run alembic upgrade head.
Run uv run uvicorn app_projects.app:app. GET /healthz checks the database.
All readers share this app workspace. Editors can change records.
IDs, timestamps and the child foreign key are read-only.
Use only synthetic data for evaluation. Tests require their own database.
Set TEST_AUTH_HEADERS to a JSON object of test client headers.
Set TEST_AUTH_COOKIES to a JSON object of test client cookies.
These are test-client inputs. The application never reads them.
Run uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.


## Authentication

Set JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE, JWT_ISSUER and JWT_AUDIENCE. Use an RS256 token with sub, iat, exp, iss, aud, and role=editor for writes. Public RSA keys must have at least 2048 bits.


## Objects

This app has no object store.
PUT, GET and DELETE /objects/{key} accept safe keys of 1 to 80 characters. Objects are at most 1 MiB. PUT returns SHA-256. A same-body retry is safe. A different body with the same key returns 409. Object writes and database writes are separate operations.


## Workflow

GET <parent-path>/{parent_id}/export processes up to 1000 children in ID order. The workflow is json_export. Larger results return 413. CSV apps also accept POST <parent-path>/{parent_id}/import with text/csv and 1 to 20 rows. Headers must match custom child fields. \N means null. CSV import commits once or rolls back all rows.

    return {
            "name": "sample",
    }


def child_payload():
    return {
            "title": "sample",
            "external_code": "sample",
    }


class RelatedServiceTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_scoped_crud_and_restriction(self):
        with TestClient(app, headers=json.loads(os.environ["TEST_AUTH_HEADERS"]), cookies=json.loads(os.environ.get("TEST_AUTH_COOKIES", "{}"))) as client:

from pymongo import AsyncMongoClient

    from .models import Survey, Question
    await database.command("ping")
    hello = await client.admin.command("hello")
    if not hello.get("setName") and hello.get("msg") != "isdbgrid":
        raise RuntimeError("MongoDB transactions require a replica set or mongos")
    await init_beanie(database=database, document_models=[Survey, Question])
    for model in (Survey, Question):
        collection = model.get_pymongo_collection()
        for name, info in model.UNIQUE_FIELDS.items():
            if info["unique"]:
                await collection.create_index(name, unique=True, partialFilterExpression={name: {"$type": info["bson_type"]}})
        for columns in model.QUERY_INDEXES:
            await collection.create_index([(name, 1) for name in columns])

    try:

    finally:
